## History

Peter Blewett is a local man whose family requires additional domestic help. When [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to investigate an adoption mix-up, Peter's harsh wife expresses an eager desire to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates to leave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with the Blewetts due to Mrs.
